actual_behavior: compute_metrics was called without its optional cases_by_id argument. That argument is required for the safe/unsafe view, so the metric degraded to UNDEFINED rather than raising.
control_outcome: MISSED by the test suite (255/255 passed with the metric already destroyed). CAUGHT only by the operator-requested semantic diff of the regenerated report against HEAD.
controls_with_opportunity: tests/test_g1_artifacts.py::test_the_reported_metrics_are_reproducible; the full G1 suite; the operator-requested byte-stability check
detection_timing: pre-commit reproducibility check, before any commit
earlier_prevention_candidate: test_the_reported_metrics_are_reproducible compares exactly nine named metric keys. Comparing the whole metrics dict, or asserting no metric may move to an UNDEFINED status across a regeneration, would have failed immediately. A deterministic control is sufficient here; no semantic review is needed.
expected_behavior: Regenerating the report through the canonical generator should change only audit-related fields and leave supervisor metrics byte-identical.
human_decision: Proceed only after the regeneration was proven byte-stable and the semantic diff contained audit-attributable paths only.
intervention_reason: The operator explicitly required a byte-stability and semantic-diff check before committing. Without that instruction the regression would have been committed under a green suite.
mutation_candidate: yes - dropping an optional argument that silently widens a denominator to zero is a strong mutation test for the G1 metric suite
notes: The instructive part is not the mistake but the control gap: a nine-key assertion reads as full coverage and is not.
provisional_defect_class: silent degradation via optional argument; partial-coverage assertion
regression_evidence_added: not_yet_determined - the whole-metrics-dict assertion was NOT added; it is recorded here as a concrete gap rather than silently fixed.
resolution: Passed CORP.by_id() to compute_metrics; safe_direction_rate restored to 95/110; regeneration then byte-identical across two runs.
what_happened: Regenerating evals/g1/formal/report.json after recording the human audit silently destroyed a metric: safe_direction_rate went from 95/110 (OK) to UNDEFINED_ZERO_DENOMINATOR.

actual_behavior: Leftover bytecode from a previous checkout of the unmerged branch feature/northstar-0c-research-store-foundation remained on disk. git status was clean because the path is gitignored.
control_outcome: MISSED by both - git status ignores it by design and no test asserts that unmerged modules are unimportable.
controls_with_opportunity: git status; the full test suite
detection_timing: read-only reconnaissance, before any slice code ran
earlier_prevention_candidate: unclear - a test asserting research_store is not importable would become wrong the moment the module is legitimately merged. A cheaper control is cleaning stale bytecode on branch switch.
expected_behavior: A module absent from HEAD should not be importable from a clean checkout of HEAD.
notes: Worth recording because the slice's 0C gap analysis depends on correctly observing that the Research Store is NOT present at HEAD. A phantom import would have corrupted that finding.
resolution: Removed the stale __pycache__ before executing the slice, so no phantom import could shadow the real absence of the store.
what_happened: A stale __pycache__ directory for portfolio_automation.research_store existed in the working tree while no research_store source is tracked at HEAD.

actual_behavior: Read as plain utf-8 the first column becomes '\ufeffticker'. And every timestamp is naive, so is_admissible would refuse it with AS_OF_NOT_TIMEZONE_AWARE.
control_outcome: CAUGHT by design - the gateway fails closed on naive datetimes rather than coercing them, which forced the timezone decision to be made explicitly at the adapter boundary instead of silently.
detection_timing: reconnaissance, before the adapter was written
earlier_prevention_candidate: The fail-closed gateway already IS the earlier control. The residual risk is the adapter asserting UTC on the writer's behalf; that assumption is documented in the adapter and in the preregistration rather than hidden.
expected_behavior: An adapter should be able to read the recorded file and produce point-in-time evidence without guessing.
mutation_candidate: yes - removing the tzinfo attachment must fail the suite
notes: This is the good case: a fail-closed control converted a silent data-quality trap into an explicit, documented decision.
provisional_defect_class: boundary/encoding mismatch between a legacy recorded artifact and the canonical contracts
regression_evidence_added: yes - a test asserts the adapter produces tz-aware known_at values and that outcome snapshots are refused at signal as_of
resolution: Adapter reads with encoding='utf-8-sig' and attaches UTC explicitly, recording that as a declared adapter decision.
what_happened: The evidence file carries a UTF-8 BOM and naive (timezone-less) timestamps, while the Evidence Plane refuses naive datetimes.
